summary: Frontend hybrid-auth regression verification PASSED end-to-end on the production preview using mobile viewport (390x844). Login stores rtn_access_token/rtn_refresh_token in localStorage, /api/auth/me works with Bearer-only (credentials omit), profile bio+location edit persists after reload, gallery loads (empty then populated), image upload via both /api/upload (avatar) and /api/gallery/upload works with no 'Not authenticated' error, and session persists after page refresh with no infinite refresh/reload loop.

test_results.tokens_in_localStorage: PASS - rtn_access_token (225 chars JWT) and rtn_refresh_token both present
test_results.bearer_only_me: PASS - fetch /api/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer and credentials:'omit' returned 200 (no cookie needed)
test_results.profile_edit_save: PASS - PUT /api/profile 200; bio and location persisted after full page reload (verified via re-read of inputs)
test_results.gallery_loads: PASS - GET /api/gallery/user/{id} 200; empty-state 'Your gallery is empty' shown, no 'Not authenticated' error
test_results.avatar_upload: PASS - POST /api/upload 200; new avatar visible; served via /api/files/... 200
test_results.gallery_upload: PASS - POST /api/gallery/upload 200; new item appears (count 1); image renders in gallery
test_results.session_persists_on_refresh: PASS - after reload token still in localStorage, still on /, only two /auth/me calls (no loop)
test_results.no_refresh_loop: PASS - navigation counts stayed low across full flow
test_results.no_not_authenticated_errors: PASS - body.innerText never contained 'Not authenticated' after any action

critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext response interceptor correctly skips retry for /api/auth/login and /api/auth/refresh, and posts refresh_token via body — matches backend that now accepts refresh_token from body OR cookie.

Backend login response body now returns access_token+refresh_token in addition to setting cookies — safe hybrid; mobile PWA/cross-site production will work via bearer even when 3rd-party cookies are blocked.
get_current_user accepting Authorization: Bearer as fallback is verified end-to-end (bearer-only /me returned 200 with credentials:'omit').

Minor: two <input type="file"> exist on profile page simultaneously (avatar hidden input + gallery modal input). Not a bug (both use dedicated buttons), but a data-testid on each file input would improve testability.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend integration only, all API responses observed 200)

seed_data_creation: During test: uploaded 1 avatar and 1 gallery image (1x1 PNG) for admin user; profile bio updated to 'Testing hybrid auth bio <ts>' and location to 'Rebel HQ - Idaho'. Main agent may want to reset these if a clean slate is required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview is same-origin so both cookie and bearer auth paths work here. To simulate the original mobile production bug (3rd-party cookie blocked), we forced credentials:'omit' on /api/auth/me and it still returned 200 via Bearer — confirming the hybrid auth wiring. Bottom nav uses data-testid='mobile-nav-profile'; gallery upload uses data-testid='gallery-upload-btn' which opens an 'Upload to Gallery' modal — the second input[type=file] on the page is inside that modal, followed by clicking the 'Share' text button.
